title: ops sprint sync prep - Samir scratchpad
body:
Context / goal:
- Prep notes for next weekly ops sync (team: serving runtime + infra + console). Keep short, surface risks and decisions, capture action owners.
- Meeting target: 45 min, focused operational topics before we dive into deep design in separate follow-ups.

Attendees (expected): Samir, Maya, Ellie, Arjun, Lin (partial), SRE reps (TBD)

Proposed agenda (45m):
1) Quick wins & metrics (5m) -- Maya
   - P50/P95 token latency last 7d: trending +8% (region us-west)
   - Top error spike: KV cache OOM on 03/10 (ephemeral)
2) Incidents / oncall handoff (8m) -- SRE rep
   - Brief timeline of KV OOM: 03/10 02:14-02:52, rollback by runtime-hotfix-2
   - Impact: degraded throughput for dedicated pools (customer X), 2 retries observed
   - Follow-up: root cause analysis kick-off (JIRA INF-3245)
3) Console rollout / feature toggles (6m) -- Ellie
   - Canary for per-route cost breakdown enabled in prod for 10% of routes
   - UX feedback: a11y issue reported on cost chart tooltip (ticket linked)
4) Capacity & autoscale changes (8m) -- Arjun
   - Proposed autoscale policy tweak: reduce scale-down grace to 90s for g4dn pools
   - Risk: transient CPU spikes could cause flapping; test plan outlined
5) Model variants & fallback policy (6m) -- Samir
   - Need to finalize fallback mapping for small models (<4B) when low-latency tier saturated
   - Proposal: fallback sequence small-opt->small-quant->gpt-lite (sketch attached)
6) Action review & AOB (12m) -- all

Notes / scratch thoughts:
- Keep this meeting focused on ops decisions only; deep design to design-review slot.
- Consider a short rotating section "Showcase" once per month for interesting perf wins.
- We should add a brief customer impact summary line for any incident (helps CSM + support).

Open questions:
- Who owns the perf regression alert tuning? (Maya volunteered to draft thresholds, follow-up to assign)
- Can console tooltip a11y fix go into emergency patch or wait for next release? Need Ellie input.
- Autoscale test: do we have an infra lab with realistic arrival patterns? If not, schedule a small soak.

Action items (tracking) -- rough, convert to JIRA after meeting:
- [ ] INF-3246: Draft RCA outline for KV cache OOM, include heap snapshot, last 3 restarts -- owner: Samir -- due: 2026-03-18
- [ ] INF-3247: Adjust prod alert thresholds for P95 token latency (proposal) -- owner: Maya -- due: 2026-03-15
- [ ] INF-3248: Console tooltip a11y patch and test cases -- owner: Ellie -- due: 2026-03-17
- [ ] INF-3249: Autoscale grace experiment configuration + canary run schedule -- owner: Arjun -- due: 2026-03-20
- [ ] INF-3250: Fallback mapping doc for small models (sketch -> RFC) -- owner: Samir + Lin -- due: 2026-03-22

Prep checklist for meeting (my personal):
- Pull last 7 day latency graphs (done)
- Short note for RCA timeline + attach logs (partial)
- Add runbook link in meeting notes (link copied below)
- Ping SRE for attendance and owner for OOM incident (done: pinged @sre-oncall)

Useful links (placeholders to convert to artifacts):
- Runtime weekly notes (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Runtime+Weekly+Notes
- RCA ticket: JIRA:INF-3245
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789
- Console repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console
- Slack thread: #runtime-team (search "KV OOM 03/10")

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy to meeting notes):
- Decision summary: short sentence per decision
- Action items: owner, ticket, due date
- Customer impact note: yes/no and short description
- Next meeting topics: up to 2 items to avoid scope creep

Random TODO (later):
- Draft brief script for customer support to explain fallback behavior when a route falls back to quantized model.
- Collect 2 sample request traces where cache hit-rate dropped below 40% last week.

Scratch end.
